prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: photorealistic reconstruction of an original VGA game opponent portrait, intended for a 4x working image before final game-palette reduction.
Input image: the attached original 74x79 portrait crop is the SOLE edit target and visual reference. Reconstruct this actual person from the original portrait.
Primary request: produce a clean, cohesive, believable real-person photographic portrait with plausible facial and material detail. Recover natural eyes, skin, hair, fabric and accessory details while staying close to the original face geometry, head shape, proportions, silhouette, pose, expression, gaze, clothing, framing, and lighting direction.
Style: natural photographic realism, modest soft studio lighting and clear readable small-scale detail. Ordinary real person, preserving distinctive imperfect/asymmetric features. Fully resolve the source into a photograph. Do not preserve or reproduce original pixel grids, pixel clusters, dithering, mosaic patches, rough low-resolution texture, or blocky edges. No painted style, grit, excessive skin pores, sharpening halos, beauty retouching, glamorous redesign, exaggerated expressions, or illustration.
Composition: full-bleed portrait ONLY, proportional 74:79 width:height crop, EXACT same framing and placement as the original source; same amount of shoulders and same silhouette. Do NOT impose a 4:5/VGA display correction on this file. Intended working size about296x316 photo pixels (inside a320x332 original-game tile), but a larger clear source photograph is acceptable.
Constraints: no UI, no border, no original top-right number, no text, no watermark. No props or accessories beyond what is specified in the original. Do not use any earlier generated image as a reference.
Subject: Bernie, as shown in the original: side-parted brown hair, the same original dark rectangular glasses shape and size, original slightly tentative closed-mouth expression, original facial asymmetry and gaze, green checked shirt over a white undershirt. Preserve the garment's original collar opening and colors; do not replace his glasses with a fashionable redesigned frame or make the face conventionally handsome.
Backdrop: completely flat, uniform, solid RGB(255,246,0), #FFF600. Precisely that same color everywhere outside the subject, with NO gradient, glow, noise, texture, shadows, lighting variation or vignette.

edits.prompt:

Input image 1 is the full-resolution photographic edit target. Input image 2 is the small original game portrait, used ONLY as a supporting color reference for the shirt collar.
Change ONLY the color of the TWO FOLDED COLLAR PANELS of his checked shirt (the left and right collar/lapel immediately beside and below his neck) to an unmistakable rich medium GREEN like the collar in the original game image. Make these two collar panels visibly green rather than muted brown/olive. Preserve their exact shapes, folded cloth shading, seams, woven fabric texture and existing subtle check pattern.
Strict invariants: leave ALL pixels/appearance outside those two collar panels unchanged as closely as possible. In particular keep the rest of the shirt body and shoulders with its existing brown-green checked colors, white undershirt, face, glasses, eyes, hair, skin, expression, gaze, pose, proportions, crop, framing, lighting, sharpness and solid yellow background exactly as input image 1. Do not recolor the whole shirt, do not add anything, and do not redesign or re-render the person. This is a tiny localized collar color edit only. Return the same full-resolution composition, no text, no border.
edits.review: Both collar panels are visibly richer green with fold shading and check texture. Face, glasses, expression, pose, framing, yellow backdrop, and rest of shirt visually preserved.

edits.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: targeted correction of the retained high-resolution Otto opponent portrait for Stunts.
Input 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the existing clean full-resolution reconstructed photograph. Input 2 is the original game portrait, supporting reference for the unchanged identity, pose, crop and clothing silhouette only.
Edit ONLY the following requested details on input 1, preserving the same man, face shape, head angle, eyes/gaze, raised hand and fingers, moustache shape, hair, shoulder positions, lighting, sharp photographic quality, exact 74:79 crop and solid purple background:
1. Make the single circular monocle rim unmistakably rich metallic GOLD, clearly warm yellow-gold, with a clean readable rim around the same lens. Keep exactly one eyepiece in exactly its existing position, held by the same raised hand; do not add spectacles.
2. Add an unmistakably visible fine monocle retaining cord attached to the ring itself. The cord should first hang vertically downward under gravity beside the cheek on the same side as the raised hand, then curve at shoulder level over that shoulder and disappear behind the neck. Show a clear continuous connection from ring to cord and a convincing vertical hanging section. A fine muted golden-brown/tan cord with readable contrast is appropriate; it must remain visible after small-resolution reduction. It must not hang all the way down the front of the shirt, not cross the throat, not float, and not end without attaching or disappearing behind the neck. Remove the existing thick black dangling cord that runs down the front.
3. Clothing: a lightweight dark charcoal fabric jacket, fully unzipped, with visible metallic zipper teeth on both separated front edges. Light fabric construction, not a heavy leather coat or formal blazer. Underneath is a plain BLACK crew-neck T-shirt (not purple). Preserve the current collar/shoulder silhouette and crop as closely as possible.
4. Mouth: lips gently pushed forward and puckered into a small rounded kiss-shaped O formation, BUT THE LIPS ARE CLOSED and touching. A tiny closed rounded puckered mouth beneath the moustache, no open mouth cavity and no visible teeth. Preserve the moustache's handlebar curls and the rest of the expression; only the lips change.
Background: perfectly flat solid RGB(182,32,255), with no shadows/gradient/noise. No number, lettering, frame, UI, watermark, added accessories, illustration, pixel art, dithering, grain, artificial skin speckles or sharpening halos. Do not alter anything outside the requested ring/cord, clothing material/zipper/undershirt, and lips. Preserve full-resolution clean photograph detail; palette pixel art will be done afterward.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit only the monocle retaining cord in this otherwise finished photograph. Keep everything else exactly unchanged, including the gold monocle, all face/hand/moustache detail, puckered CLOSED kiss lips, black shirt, open lightweight dark zip jacket, purple background, crop and photographic sharpness.
The cord currently incorrectly forks near shoulder level into TWO paths, with an extra loose dangling vertical tail continuing down the front beside the neck. REMOVE THAT EXTRA LOWER FRONT TAIL. There must be just ONE continuous unbranched fine golden-brown cord: attached to the monocle ring, hanging vertically straight down alongside the cheek, then turning in one gentle curve across the visible shoulder on the same side as the raised hand and disappearing BEHIND the neck at the rear collar. Retain the visible upper vertical segment and shoulder curve; erase the redundant vertical segment below the point where the shoulder curve branches away. No fork, no second string, no loose front end, no new jewellery. The shoulder curve must look natural under gravity, with a continuous ring-to-shoulder-to-behind-neck route.
Do not regenerate the portrait or change any unrelated pixel. Return the same full-resolution image.
edits.status: selected final: user explicitly chose the version with the cord curving over the shoulder
